description: Human sign-off register for the contract suite mainnet readiness checklist. The automated half of the checklist is derived from repository state by apps/onchain/scripts/mainnet-readiness.mjs; this file records the half that only a person can sign. Edit status to "signed" and add signed_by/signed_at once the owner has accepted the item, then regenerate docs/MAINNET_READINESS_CHECKLIST.md.

items.title: Independent security review of the deployed contract set completed and findings triaged
items.note: No dedicated review issue is open; procurement and review are recorded against this checklist.

items.title: Upgrade rehearsal evidence reviewed and accepted against a deployed timelock-controlled contract
items.note: UPGRADE-REHEARSAL-001 records that no timelock-controllable contract is currently deployed to rehearse against.

items.title: Emergency pause drill evidence reviewed for every pause scope
items.note: docs/EMERGENCY_PAUSE_DRILL.md defines the drill; it has not been exercised against a deployed contract.

items.title: Admin key custody, signer set and rotation procedure approved
items.note: docs/threat-model.md §6 defines the custody posture; rotation has not been exercised against a live deployment.

items.title: Authorization inventory signed off for every privileged entry point
items.note: No contract-side authorization inventory exists yet (docs/AUTHORIZATION_MATRIX.md covers backend controllers only).

items.title: Storage archival and restore policy approved, including which entry classes may be archived
items.note: TTL bump policy exists in apps/onchain/CONTRIBUTING.md, but no restore path is defined for archived entries.

items.title: Contracts-area go/no-go confirmed against the mainnet launch runbook
items.note: The runbook must name the contracts criterion, its owner and how it is verified.

items.title: Deployer account funding approved at or above the simulated mainnet total plus initialization headroom
items.note: Estimate lives in apps/onchain/deploy-cost-mainnet-estimate.json and must be re-run immediately before deployment.
